name: natural-parallel-test
description: Stress-test plans against nature by shared mechanism rather than resemblance

plugins.name: npt
plugins.description: The Natural Parallel Test. Decomposes a plan into ten mechanisms, searches seven levels of nature for systems solving the same problem under comparable constraints, refutes the weak analogies with an adversarial reviewer, and returns a scored verdict: Established, Partial, Novel but compatible, or Contrary to natural patterns.
